text:
maria_docs: Heads-up — opened a tiny docs PR to pin deps in the Python hello quickstart and add a note about the Docker base image for first deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
alex_platform: 👍 will review later today. Does pinning break compatibility with our hosted samples?
maria_docs: Shouldn't — pins are conservative (requests==2.31.0, redwood-sdk==0.9.1). Left a note that users can use newer versions if needed.
tim_engineer: Quick q: the Dockerfile in the tutorial uses python:3.11-slim — changed to python:3.11-bullseye-slim to avoid musl issues on some hosters. Any objections?
alex_platform: Fine. Add brief justification in the PR description — CI base images differ on alpine.
sam_devex: Also saw one broken link to /sdk/python/auth — fixed that in the PR.
ci-bot: builds/docs — test started for PR #4321
maria_docs: Thanks — also added a minimal auth snippet using env var REDWOOD_API_KEY and a fallback for ~/.redwood/token.

maria_docs: ```
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY hello-image
``` 

tim_engineer: For the fallback sample, maybe show how to mount the token file: `-v ~/.redwood:/root/.redwood` and run with `--env-file`? Add that.
maria_docs: done — updated the snippet and added a short note about secrets (KMS for private deploys).
alex_platform: Left one nit about wording: change "first deployment" -> "first push" — tiny wording.
maria_docs: fixed, PTAL.
ci-bot: builds/docs — passed for PR #4321 :white_check_mark:
sam_devex: Merged?
maria_docs: Not yet; waiting on one more review from @jonah_sales regarding the enterprise KMS blurb.
jonah_sales: Reviewing now; will approve if the KMS paragraph is marked optional.
jonah_sales: Approved.
maria_docs: Merged. Thanks all :tada:
sam_devex: Can we add a short migration note in the release notes for users who used alpine-based images? Small follow-up ticket?
alex_platform: Yes — I'll create a docs/infra issue and tag infra.
sam_devex: created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/198 — added to next sprint.
maria_docs: Thanks team.
